name: Banyeres de Mariola (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with a blue oval bearing Saint George on horseback slaying the dragon, between two crowned municipal shields of Banyeres de Mariola (the Senyera above a castle).
history: Municipal flag of Banyeres de Mariola; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: oval with Saint George slaying the dragon
Banyeres de Mariola arms — Senyera above a castle, repeated at hoist and fly
